# Crystal

Type: Material | Internal ID: Crystal | Source: Frost Blob, ,, Stone Golem | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Crystal is a material found in the Mountains.

## Availability

• Drop from Stone Golem.
• Found in clusters inside Frost Caves.
• Drop from Frost Blob.

### Building

• Crystal wall

### Crafting

• Crystal battleaxe
• Crystal Heart
• Dvergr lantern

## Notes

• The pickable crystals inside caves only drop one crystal each when picked. However, they are also easily destructible, and when destroyed they will drop 1–3 crystals each instead.
